summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K furnishing Company Announcement no. 47, a routine disclosure under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation (the US-equivalent Form 4/insider-transaction report) of share sales by a managerial employee. CEO Jan G. J. van de Winkel sold Genmab shares in multiple lots priced between roughly DKK 3,581 and DKK 3,658, reducing his personal holding from 668,024 to 646,024 shares (a 22,000-share sale). No corporate transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is involved. This is ordinary insider dealing disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle exists.
